children: Anavex completed clinical conduct of ADME and DDI studies for blarcamesine, advancing pharmacology data to support its Alzheimer’s, Rett and Fragile X programs.
DDI study fully enrolled with 65 healthy volunteers dosed at 30 mg; last participant completed in late September.
ADME study enrolled 8 healthy volunteers dosed at 30 mg; last participant completed in mid‑October.
No serious adverse events reported in preliminary observations; full safety and PK analyses are ongoing.
FDA cleared the IND for Fragile X syndrome; study start‑up activities are underway.
FDA meeting scheduled for November to discuss adding pediatric participants to the Phase 3 Rett syndrome trial.
